author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಂಡಾಣು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಂಡ ನಿಂತಿಹುದು
ಪಿಂಡಾಂಡದಿಂದುದಯ ಜೀವವೈವಿಧ್ಯ
ಪಿಂಡಜದಿ ಮಾನವನು ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠಬುದ್ಧಿಯ ಜೀವಿ
ಬಿಡುನಿನ್ನ ವಕ್ರತೆಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The whole cosmos rests on the creation of the egg;
from the individual body springs the diversity of life;
among the womb-born, man is the being of finest intellect:
give up your crookedness, O deluded one.
en.note: The verse plays on brahmāṇḍa (the cosmic egg), piṇḍāṇḍa (the individual body as a small cosmos) and piṇḍaja (womb-born creatures).
en.bhavartha: The universe and every living body arise from the same seed of creation, and from it comes all the variety of life. Among living beings, humans have been given the finest intellect, so it ill becomes us to be crooked.
